display.label: AWS Region
display.description: AWS region for the SNS topic.

display.label: SNS Endpoint Override
display.description: Optional SNS endpoint override (for local testing with LocalStack).

display.label: AWS Credentials Profile
display.description: AWS credentials profile name to use for authentication.

display.label: Default Topic ARN
display.description: Default SNS topic ARN to publish messages to.

display.label: Topic ARN Prefix
display.description: Prefix to prepend to the destination name to compose the full topic ARN.

display.label: Default Retries
display.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests. Default: 5

display.label: Message Group ID Header
display.description: Header name to use as the MessageGroupId. Applies to FIFO topics, and to standard topics when 'message.group.id.enabled' is true. Default: aggregateId

display.label: Default Message Group ID
display.description: Default MessageGroupId when neither a header value nor a record key is found. Applies to FIFO topics, and to standard topics when 'message.group.id.enabled' is true. Default: default

display.label: Message Group ID Enabled
display.description: When true, set MessageGroupId on standard (non-FIFO) topics as well, to enable Amazon SQS fair queues on subscribed standard queues. On standard topics MessageGroupId is a tenant identifier for fairness and does not enforce ordering. The value is resolved the same way as for FIFO topics: from the header configured by 'message.group.id.header', falling back to the record key, then 'message.group.id.default'. FIFO topics are unaffected. Defaults to false, preserving existing behavior. Default: false

display.label: FIFO Message Deduplication ID Header
display.description: Header name to use as the MessageDeduplicationId for FIFO topics.
